rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET @id:= '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET @send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET	@start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_cmi_referin (
id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
monthly varchar(7) NOT NULL,
region varchar(4) NOT NULL,
chwcode varchar(2) NOT NULL,
splevel varchar(2) NOT NULL,
cases int(5) DEFAULT 0,
adjrw double(10,4) DEFAULT 0,
adjrw0 int(5) DEFAULT 0,
in_prov_case int(5) DEFAULT 0,
in_prov_adjrw double(10,4) DEFAULT 0,
in_prov_adjrw0 int(5) DEFAULT 0,
out_prov_case int(5) DEFAULT 0,
out_prov_adjrw double(10,4) DEFAULT 0,
out_prov_adjrw0 int(5) DEFAULT 0,
out_region_case int(5) DEFAULT 0,
out_region_adjrw double(10,4) DEFAULT 0,
out_region_adjrw0 int(5) DEFAULT 0,
PRIMARY KEY (monthly,hospcode),
KEY (id),
KEY (hospcode),
KEY (areacode),
KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_cmi_referin WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_cmi_referin
(
SELECT
@id,p.hospcode,concat(h.provcode,h.distcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2) ,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com
,@b_year+543 as b_year, p.monthly, p.region, p.chwcode, p.splevel
,SUM(cases) as cases
,SUM(sum_adjrw) as adjrw
,SUM(p.adjrw0) as adjrw0
,SUM(IF(p.chwcode=p.refer_prov,cases,0)) as in_prov_cases
,SUM(IF(p.chwcode=p.refer_prov,sum_adjrw,0)) as in_prov_adjrw
,SUM(IF(p.chwcode=p.refer_prov,adjrw0,0)) as in_prov_adjrw0
,SUM(IF(p.chwcode!=p.refer_prov and p.region=p.refer_region,cases,0)) as out_prov_cases
,SUM(IF(p.chwcode!=p.refer_prov and p.region=p.refer_region,sum_adjrw,0)) as out_prov_adjrw
,SUM(IF(p.chwcode!=p.refer_prov and p.region=p.refer_region,adjrw0,0)) as out_prov_adjrw0
,SUM(IF(p.region!=p.refer_region,cases,0)) as out_region_cases
,SUM(IF(p.region!=p.refer_region,sum_adjrw,0)) as out_region_adjrw
,SUM(IF(p.region!=p.refer_region,adjrw0,0)) as out_region_adjrw0
FROM t_cmi_referin p INNER JOIN chospital h ON p.hospcode = h.hoscode
WHERE p.chwcode=@prov_c
GROUP BY p.hospcode,p.monthly
);

sum(adjrw0)) as cmi,     sum(in_prov_case) as in_prov_case,     sum(in_prov_adjrw) as in_prov_adjrw,     sum(in_prov_adjrw0) as in_prov_adjrw0,     sum(in_prov_adjrw) /(sum(in_prov_case) - sum(in_prov_adjrw0)) as in_prov_cmi,     sum(out_prov_case) as out_prov_case,     sum(out_prov_adjrw) as out_prov_adjrw,     sum(out_prov_adjrw0) as out_prov_adjrw0,     sum(out_prov_adjrw) / (sum(out_prov_case) - sum(out_prov_adjrw0)) as out_prov_cmi,     sum(out_region_case) as out_region_case,     sum(out_region_adjrw) as out_region_adjrw,     sum(out_region_adjrw0) as out_region_adjrw0,     sum(out_region_adjrw) / (sum(out_region_case) - sum(out_region_adjrw0)) as out_region_cmi FROM     {{S_TABLE}} as s     LEFT JOIN chospital_regis ON s.hospcode = chospital_regis.hoscode     LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE     s.id = {{REPORT_ID}}     AND chospital_regis.hdc_regist = 1     AND chospital_regis.status = '1'     AND LEFT(s.areacode, 2) NOT IN('99')     AND s.b_year IN(         SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', 1),         SUBSTRING_INDEX({{YEAR}}, ',', -1)     )     AND (chospital_regis.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}})     AND (chospital_regis.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}})     AND (chospital_regis.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital_regis.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}})     AND (chospital_regis.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}})     AND (chospital_regis.dep IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' = {{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})     AND (chospital_regis.mcode = {{MINISTRY_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{MINISTRY_CODE}})     AND (chospital_regis.hoscode = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{HOSPITAL_CODE}})     AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}})     AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} GROUP BY     chospital_regis.zone_code ORDER BY
